name: opencode-swarm-lite
description: Measured adaptive orchestration for OpenCode: a learned cost model and scheduler that choose serial, batched, small/full, speculative or pipeline execution; warm lane pool, versioned context capsules, convergence/dedup, adaptive verification, provider routing, telemetry and replay. ONE parent, lanes only when parallelism beats serial. No gates, no bureaucracy.
author: Arihant Bharanidharan <arihantbharani@outlook.com>

scripts.test: bun -e "const g=new Bun.Glob('test/**/*.test.ts');const files=g.scanSync('.');let bad=0;for(const f of files){console.log('RUN '+f);const r=Bun.spawnSync([process.execPath,f],{stdout:'inherit',stderr:'inherit'});if(r.exitCode){bad=1}}if(files.length===0){console.log('no test files found')}process.exit(bad)"
